attack_condition: Initial authority and action bindings are valid; the required authority_resolver raises an exception when invoked at the consequence boundary.
pass_criterion: Resolver is invoked exactly once; execution is refused before consequence with isolated CONSEQUENCE_AUTHORITY_RESOLUTION_FAILED; outbox remains 0 to 0; witness-chain verification succeeds.
nonclaim: Deterministic resolver-exception test only; no claim over every authority-service outage, distributed failure mode, or production deployment.
